title: Overlays
summary: See-through graphics made to sit on top of footage, shown here over the sample clip: found-footage framing, fog, film damage and failing light for mood; flickering titles, typed date stamps and case-file documents for telling the story. They stutter on, stay uneasy while they are up, and cut out before their time ends. By default they keep to the top, bottom and edges so the speaker's face stays clear.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"piece": "overlays/timestamp", "start": 1.2, "end": 4.4, "props": {"date": "OCTOBER 31", "time": "3:14 AM", "place": "…", "y": 1500}}. Positions are in 1080×1920 frame pixels. Mood overlays (camcorder, vignette-fog, film-damage) can run the whole clip. Files: library/themes/horror/overlays/pieces/.

items.name: Camcorder frame
items.description: Found-footage framing: corner brackets, blinking REC, running timecode, date, tape mode, low battery and a rolling tracking line.

items.name: Vignette and fog
items.description: Atmosphere for a whole clip: a heavy vignette, slow fog rolling along the top and bottom, fine grain.

items.name: Film damage
items.description: Old film stock: running scratches, dust and hairs, a breathing dark gate, grain and the odd flash frame.

items.name: Creeping shadow
items.description: Soft fingers of darkness lengthening in from the edges of the frame, never quite still.

items.name: Light in the dark
items.description: A cold shaft of light from an upper corner that flares, dips and cuts out like a bad bulb, with dust drifting through it.

items.name: Signal loss
items.description: Bursts of dead-channel noise with torn bands and a NO SIGNAL box, and thin crawls of noise in between.

items.name: Flickering title
items.description: A title switching on between two hairlines while a lamp flares and fails behind it.

items.name: Scratched title
items.description: A word in chipped, worn capitals with rough gouges scratched across it and a handwritten note beneath.

items.name: Date and place stamp
items.description: A date, time and place typed out line by line at the lower left.

items.name: Counter
items.description: A figure that rolls through wrong digits and settles, with a tracked line above and a label below.

items.name: Case file
items.description: A case-file card on aged paper: typed heading and rows, and a worn stamp thumped across the corner.

items.name: Redacted lines
items.description: Typewritten document lines; chosen words are struck out by marker bars just after they are typed.

items.name: Evidence tag
items.description: A numbered evidence marker with a typed note and an unsteady line to the thing it marks.

items.name: Case notes
items.description: A heading and short numbered lines that switch on one at a time.

items.name: Heartbeat
items.description: A heart-monitor trace with a bright head and a BPM readout that climbs.

items.name: Dread meter
items.description: A hairline meter filling toward a percentage, trembling harder the higher it gets.
